apiBoundary: src/services/api.ts — all backend calls go through this module; no inline fetch/HTTP in components

researchLayers.name: routing-pages
researchLayers.targets: App routes, src/pages/ (Home, Products, ProductDetail, Chat, Checkout, Orders, OrderConfirmation, Users, Architecture), navigation

researchLayers.name: state
researchLayers.targets: src/contexts/ (DarkMode...), src/hooks/, URL-driven state, window events (cartUpdated/authChanged/authExpired)

researchLayers.name: api-types
researchLayers.targets: src/services/api.ts methods, src/types/, OCC + coremcp agent/knowledge/visual-search contracts, auth/cart lifecycle

researchLayers.name: build-config
researchLayers.targets: vite.config.ts (proxy, aliases), env vars, eslint/tsconfig, playwright.config.ts

manualVerificationSurfaces: Dev server route — npm run dev, then the specific path the change affects
Responsive check — mobile and desktop widths, plus dark-mode variant if the app has one
Browser console + network tab — no errors, and the expected request/response shape
Loading and error states — exercise both, not just the happy path
sliceExample: Slice 1: types + api method in the apiBoundary (TYPECHECK, LINT). Slice 2: the component consuming it, with loading + error states wired (TYPECHECK, LINT, BUILD). Slice 3: the route/page it lands on plus its e2e spec (BUILD, E2E_TEST).
triggerVocabulary: components, pages, routing, hooks, contexts, state, API client, styling, storefront, OCC API client, cart, checkout
_notes: The repo's CLAUDE.md is authoritative for component/state/styling/API conventions.

This project HAS real e2e tests (Playwright, tests/*.spec.ts incl. visual-search) — E2E_TEST is a real verb, not MANUAL. Slice checkpoints that touch a flow with a spec should run E2E_TEST (or E2E_TEST_ONE for the relevant spec). There is no unit-test runner; TYPECHECK + LINT + BUILD + e2e is the gate.

Backend: coremcp MCP server at VITE_API_URL (SAP Commerce OCC v2 + agent/knowledge/visual-search). Chat.tsx + react-markdown/mermaid indicate the agent chat UI already exists here — research it before extending.
Set jira.mode to 'mcp' if the Atlassian connector is available.
